title: The Trial, Crucifixion, and Burial of Jesus

questions.question: When Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the King of the Jews?", how did Jesus reply?
options: "You have said so."
"I am a king, but not of this world."
"If you say that I am, then I am."
"No, for my kingdom is in heaven."
questions.explanation: Mark 15:2 (ESV): "And Pilate asked him, 'Are you the King of the Jews?' And he answered him, 'You have said so.'"

questions.question: Why did Pilate marvel when the chief priests accused Jesus of many things?
options: Because Jesus made no further answer
Because Jesus spoke directly to them in Latin
Because Jesus claimed to be greater than Caesar
Because Jesus summoned the wind to rattle the windows
questions.correctAnswer: Because Jesus made no further answer
questions.explanation: Mark 15:4-5 (ESV): "And Pilate again asked him, 'Have you no answer to make? See how many charges they bring against you.' But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled."

questions.question: At the feast Pilate used to release for them one prisoner for whom they asked. Who was the rebel among the murderers they asked for?
options: Barabbas
Judas the Galilean
Theudas
Dismas
questions.explanation: Mark 15:7 (ESV): "And among the rebels in prison, who had committed murder in the insurrection, there was a man called Barabbas."

questions.question: Why did Pilate perceive the chief priests had delivered Jesus up?
options: "For he perceived that it was out of envy that the chief priests had delivered him up."
"For he perceived they feared exactly what he feared, a rebellion."
"Because they genuinely believed he was a false prophet."
"He perceived that Herod had told them to do so."
questions.correctAnswer: "For he perceived that it was out of envy that the chief priests had delivered him up."
questions.explanation: Mark 15:10 (ESV): "For he perceived that it was out of envy that the chief priests had delivered him up."

questions.question: After Pilate released Barabbas, what did he do to Jesus before delivering Him to be crucified?
options: He scourged him
He mocked him with a purple cloak
He washed his hands and placed a crown of thorns on Jesus' head
He forced Him to drink sour wine
questions.explanation: Mark 15:15 (ESV): "So Pilate, wishing to satisfy the crowd, released for them Barabbas, and having scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified."

questions.question: What did the soldiers do to mock Jesus inside the courtyard of the palace (the governor's headquarters)?
options: They clothed him in a purple cloak, twisted together a crown of thorns, put it on him, and hailed him "King of the Jews!"
They gave him a reed and bowed before him holding a banner
They tied a Roman eagle to his cross and made him carry it
They offered him a royal shield and commanded he fight for it
questions.correctAnswer: They clothed him in a purple cloak, twisted together a crown of thorns, put it on him, and hailed him "King of the Jews!"
questions.explanation: Mark 15:17-18 (ESV): "And they clothed him in a purple cloak, and twisting together a crown of thorns, they put it on him. And they began to salute him, 'Hail, King of the Jews!'"

questions.question: Who did they compel to carry the cross of Jesus?
options: Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus
Nicodemus from Jerusalem
A centurion standing by
A thief from the prison
questions.correctAnswer: Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus
questions.explanation: Mark 15:21 (ESV): "And they compelled a passerby, Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to carry his cross."

questions.question: What does the place Golgotha mean?
options: Place of a Skull
Hill of Sorrows
The Mount of Blood
Valley of Shadows
questions.explanation: Mark 15:22 (ESV): "And they brought him to the place called Golgotha (which means Place of a Skull)."

questions.question: What did the soldiers offer Jesus before crucifying Him, which He did not take?
options: Wine mixed with myrrh
Water mixed with honey
Ox gall to make him sleep
Lentils and bread for strength
questions.explanation: Mark 15:23 (ESV): "And they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it."

questions.question: What inscription of the charge against Him was written over Jesus?
options: "The King of the Jews"
"Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews"
"He who tears down the temple"
"The Son of God"
questions.explanation: Mark 15:26 (ESV): "And the inscription of the charge against him read, 'The King of the Jews.'"

questions.question: From the sixth hour to the ninth hour, what happened over the whole land?
options: There was darkness over the whole land
A massive thunderstorm flashed loudly
It rained blood across all of Judea
A dense fog blanketed the streets of Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: There was darkness over the whole land
questions.explanation: Mark 15:33 (ESV): "And when the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour."

questions.question: At the ninth hour Jesus cried out: "Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?" What does this mean?
options: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
"Into your hands I commit my spirit."
"Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do."
"It is finished."
questions.correctAnswer: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"
questions.explanation: Mark 15:34 (ESV): "And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, 'Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?' which means, 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?'"

questions.question: When some of the bystanders heard Him cry out, who did they think He was calling for?
options: Elijah
Moses
An angel of mercy
God the Father
questions.explanation: Mark 15:35 (ESV): "And some of the bystanders hearing it said, 'Behold, he is calling Elijah.'"

questions.question: When Jesus uttered a loud cry and breathed His last, what happened in the temple?
options: The curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom
The altar split in half violently
The menorah extinguished itself forever
The trumpets blew on their own
questions.correctAnswer: The curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom
questions.explanation: Mark 15:38 (ESV): "And the curtain of the temple was torn in two, from top to bottom."

questions.question: Who went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus to bury Him?
options: Joseph of Arimathea, a respected member of the council
Nicodemus and John the beloved
Peter and Andrew
Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses
questions.correctAnswer: Joseph of Arimathea, a respected member of the council
questions.explanation: Mark 15:43 (ESV): "Joseph of Arimathea, a respected member of the council... took courage and went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus."

key_verse_text: And when the centurion, who stood facing him, saw that in this way he breathed his last, he said, "Truly this man was the Son of God!"
